result.summary: This is a digital survey report interface from Hotjar showing analysis for 'New survey 1', highlighting mixed user feedback, general satisfaction, and suggestions for improvements like better guidance.

ocr.full_text: x Survey report BETA AI Survey report: New survey 1 Data from June 4, 11:16 to June 11, 11:39 Jane Smith · June 11, 11:39 Share Summary The survey gathered mixed responses, indicating general satisfaction with some areas for improvement suggested. Findings • Overall, users are relatively satisfied with the current state, but there are opportunities for enhancement. • Several respondents appreciate the recent updates and find the system easy to use. • There is a desire among some users for more guided tutorials to better navigate changes. • Some resistance towards participating in surveys was noted, indicating potential survey fatigue or communication issues. Quotes "It's not bad but can be better" Hotjar curated by Mobbin Rate your experience
